# Paid social ads

**Boost and advertise on Meta, TikTok, X and Reddit inside the 2026 policies, with labelled AI creative, hard caps and honest reporting.**

Plans and runs paid social ads and post boosts on Meta (Facebook, Instagram), TikTok, X and Reddit for an AI creator, agent or product — account setup owned by a person, ad policy checks (AI-generated content labels, political and social-issue bans, crypto licensing rules, special ad categories), creative testing with AI-made assets labelled, daily budgets with account spending limits and stop rules, creator content as partnership or Spark ads, and a weekly report on cost per result. Use when someone wants to boost a post, run a first ad campaign, test ad creatives, set ad budgets and caps, check whether an ad will be approved, or read ad results.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Grow](../README.md) | intermediate | 2 h to set up, 20 min a day for the first week | — | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick what to promote from proof
2. Set up accounts and caps before any ad
3. Check the policies for this ad
4. Make 3–5 variants, one change apart
5. Use creator posts properly
6. Target simply and safely
7. Launch with approval, watch spend
8. Report weekly and decide
9. Keep records

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.
